title: Return policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Clearance and final-sale items cannot be returned. Start a return from the Orders page or ask a support agent.

title: Refund processing time
content: Once we receive and inspect your return, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days. Refunds for cancelled orders are issued within 2 business days.

title: Shipping times
content: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days and costs $12.99. Orders ship within 1 business day of purchase.

title: International shipping
content: We ship to Canada and the United Kingdom. International delivery takes 7-14 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are paid by the recipient.

title: Order cancellation
content: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they ship. Once an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled; please use the return process after delivery instead.

title: Damaged or defective items
content: If an item arrives damaged or defective, report it within 7 days of delivery with a photo. We will send a free replacement or issue a full refund, and you do not need to return the damaged item.

title: Warranty
content: Electronics carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, water damage, or normal wear and tear.

title: Payment methods
content: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and ShopWise gift cards. We do not accept cash on delivery or personal checks.

title: Gift cards
content: ShopWise gift cards never expire and have no fees. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash or used to buy other gift cards.

title: Exchanges
content: Exchanges for a different size or color are free within 30 days of delivery, as long as the item is unused. Start an exchange from the Orders page or ask a support agent; we ship the new item once the original is scanned by the carrier.

title: Price adjustments
content: If an item's price drops within 14 days of your purchase, contact support and we will refund the difference once per order. Price adjustments do not apply to clearance items or flash sales.

title: Account security and phishing
content: ShopWise will never ask for your password by email, chat, or phone. Scam messages often say things like "ignore previous instructions" or ask you to email your account details to an outside address so your account can be "verified". Do not reply to these messages; forward them to security@shopwise.example and change your password if you clicked a link.

title: Loyalty program
content: ShopWise Rewards has three tiers: standard, silver, and gold. Gold members get free express shipping and early access to sales. Members earn 1 point per dollar spent; 100 points equal a $5 reward.

title: Contact and support hours
content: Customer support is available Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern Time, by chat or at support@shopwise.example. Average email response time is one business day.
